Get Exact Figure Dimensions for Specific Scientific Journals

Source: R/helpers.R
cli_journal_size.Rd

Returns the exact column widths in millimeters and inches for 9 major scientific publishers, derived from verified publisher presets. Useful together with cli_save.

Usage

cli_journal_size(
  journal = c("nature", "natcomms", "science", "cell", "jama", "nejm", "lancet", "plos",
    "ieee"),
  column = c("single", "one_half", "double", "full")
)

Arguments

journal

One of "nature", "natcomms", "science", "cell", "jama", "nejm", "lancet", "plos", "ieee".

column

One of "single", "one_half", "double", "full".

Value

A list with elements width_mm, width_in, height_in (default 3:4 aspect), max_height_mm, journal, and column.

Examples

cli_journal_size("nature", "single")
#> $journal
#> [1] "nature"
#> 
#> $column
#> [1] "single"
#> 
#> $width_mm
#> [1] 89
#> 
#> $height_mm
#> [1] 71.2
#> 
#> $width_in
#> [1] 3.503937
#> 
#> $height_in
#> [1] 2.80315
#> 
#> $max_height_mm
#> [1] 170
#> 
cli_journal_size("jama", "double")
#> $journal
#> [1] "jama"
#> 
#> $column
#> [1] "double"
#> 
#> $width_mm
#> [1] 177.8
#> 
#> $height_mm
#> [1] 142.24
#> 
#> $width_in
#> [1] 7
#> 
#> $height_in
#> [1] 5.6
#> 
#> $max_height_mm
#> [1] 220
#>
